collection.title: SEAT Leon Hatchback 2009 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A SEAT Leon Hatchback 2009 to 2012 requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Leon which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
